trigger: Took the First Memory Draft from the Archive reading desk (merge_draft)
note: Asha on comms reacts to the merge draft. Dedicated stills (#27); VO via ElevenLabs.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Dust lifts off the draft. Names in brittle ink — each who chose the merge, one mind at a time.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: Kaela — your channel just spiked. You opened the Archive.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: Not a scare-vote. Individual choosings — people who meant to remain, and became the lattice on purpose.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: I deserted Station Seven for a sympathetic AI. This is older. Heavier.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: Keep the override if you still have it. Believe her if you must — but bring those names to the Core. Voss only hears weapons. Make him hear a people.

panels.then: title card THE DRAFT SPEAKS over the lower third
